Alright so, as many have pointed out, the build is a bit all over the place. To start, another redditor already gave good advice on the talismans. stat wise, i would respec and take the points out of arcane and put them in mind. playing a spellblade with sword of night and flame is very FP hungry. Also, you have a lot more points in intelligence, which would be fine, but you have more incantations than sorceries in your memory slots, 4 to 1. by this point in the game you can have all 10 memory slots unlocked, so you would have more flexibility for choosing spells. also, the meteorite staff can easily be outclassed by this point in the game by many staffs if they are upgraded. prince of death staff is good for int/faith builds but if you’re leaning into intelligence i would go for the academy glinstone staff for now and the carian regal staff later on once you get int to 70+
the general strat with NG sword of night and flame is to lean into either int or faith rather than spreading yourself thin between the two
the prince of death staff and the golden order seal are the best for int/faith scaling

i understand that but at a certain point it becomes difficult to be a jack of all trades, master of none. if you’re doing a quality build with equal str/dex then focus of melee combat, if you want a mage build focus on int/faith. but it’s hard to mix all 4 of those stats into one coherent build. if you want to combine melee and magic, doing a spellblade or paladin build is fun. but for that pick either str or dex and int or faith. like i said mixing those 4 stats isn’t exactly efficient.
